scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/gateway install && npm --prefix apps/jeenee install
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix apps/gateway run db:migrate && npm --prefix apps/jeenee run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,jeenee -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix apps/gateway run dev" "npm --prefix apps/jeenee run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/gateway run build && npm --prefix apps/jeenee run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n gateway,jeenee -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix apps/gateway run start" "npm --prefix apps/jeenee run start -- -p 3001"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/gateway run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/jeenee run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/gateway test && npm --prefix apps/jeenee test
